description: What the librarian window is allowed to do: drag itself by its title bar, pick folders and files to import, and reveal a workspace in the system file manager. The two window permissions are listed by name because `core:window:default` grants nothing at all — without `allow-start-dragging`, `data-tauri-drag-region` is inert, since the injected script fires, calls `start_dragging`, and has the call denied before it reaches the window manager. `allow-internal-toggle-maximize` is what the same script uses to zoom on a double-click.
